#061 · Tadpole Pokémon

Poliwhirl

Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Poliwhirl is a Water-type Tadpole Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 20 kg. It evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath and Politoed. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 385.
